시편 51:1.content: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David, when Nathan the prophet came unto him, after he had gone in to Bath–sheba. Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.

시편 51:2.content: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

시편 51:3.content: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.

시편 51:4.content: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done this evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, and be clear when thou judgest.

시편 51:5.content: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.

시편 51:6.content: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden part thou shalt make me to know wisdom.

시편 51:7.content: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

시편 51:8.content: Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.

시편 51:9.content: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.

시편 51:10.content: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.

시편 51:11.content: Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.

시편 51:12.content: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.

시편 51:13.content: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.

시편 51:14.content: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.

시편 51:15.content: O Lord, open thou my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.

시편 51:16.content: For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: thou delightest not in burnt offering.

시편 51:17.content: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

시편 51:18.content: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem.

시편 51:19.content: Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.
